questions.questionText: In a certain code language, CAT is written as DBU. How will DOG be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of CAT is moved 1 position(s) forward in the alphabet (C → D, A → B, T → U). Applying the same rule to DOG: D → E, O → P, G → H. Hence the code is EPH.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, BOOK is written as DQQM. How will PAGE be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of BOOK is moved 2 position(s) forward in the alphabet (B → D, O → Q, O → Q, K → M). Applying the same rule to PAGE: P → R, A → C, G → I, E → G. Hence the code is RCIG.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, LAMP is written as ODPS. How will DESK be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of LAMP is moved 3 position(s) forward in the alphabet (L → O, A → D, M → P, P → S). Applying the same rule to DESK: D → G, E → H, S → V, K → N. Hence the code is GHVN.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, RAIN is written as VEMR. How will SNOW be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of RAIN is moved 4 position(s) forward in the alphabet (R → V, A → E, I → M, N → R). Applying the same rule to SNOW: S → W, N → R, O → S, W → A. Hence the code is WRSA.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, GOLD is written as IQNF. How will IRON be written in the same code?

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, MIND is written as PLQG. How will SOUL be written in the same code?

questions.explanationText: Every letter of TREE is moved 1 position(s) forward in the alphabet (T → U, R → S, E → F, E → F). Applying the same rule to LEAF: L → M, E → F, A → B, F → G. Hence the code is MFBG.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, CHAIR is written as EJCKT. How will TABLE be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of CHAIR is moved 2 position(s) forward in the alphabet (C → E, H → J, A → C, I → K, R → T). Applying the same rule to TABLE: T → V, A → C, B → D, L → N, E → G. Hence the code is VCDNG.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, HOUSE is written as LSYWI. How will FIELD be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of HOUSE is moved 4 position(s) forward in the alphabet (H → L, O → S, U → Y, S → W, E → I). Applying the same rule to FIELD: F → J, I → M, E → I, L → P, D → H. Hence the code is JMIPH.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, PLANT is written as SODQW. How will STONE be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of PLANT is moved 3 position(s) forward in the alphabet (P → S, L → O, A → D, N → Q, T → W). Applying the same rule to STONE: S → V, T → W, O → R, N → Q, E → H. Hence the code is VWRQH.

questions.questionText: In a certain code language, MUSIC is written as RZXNH. How will DANCE be written in the same code?
questions.explanationText: Every letter of MUSIC is moved 5 position(s) forward in the alphabet (M → R, U → Z, S → X, I → N, C → H). Applying the same rule to DANCE: D → I, A → F, N → S, C → H, E → J. Hence the code is IFSHJ.

questions.explanationText: Each letter of WIND is moved 1 position(s) backward (W → V, I → H, N → M, D → C). Applying it to COLD gives C → B, O → N, L → K, D → C, so the code is BNKC.

questions.questionText: If RICE is coded as PGAC, what is the code for WHEAT under the same rule?
questions.explanationText: Each letter of RICE is moved 2 position(s) backward (R → P, I → G, C → A, E → C). Applying it to WHEAT gives W → U, H → F, E → C, A → Y, T → R, so the code is UFCYR.

questions.explanationText: Each letter of LIGHT is moved 3 position(s) backward (L → I, I → F, G → D, H → E, T → Q). Applying it to SOUND gives S → P, O → L, U → R, N → K, D → A, so the code is PLRKA.

questions.questionText: If GLASS is coded as FKZRR, what is the code for METAL under the same rule?
questions.explanationText: Each letter of GLASS is moved 1 position(s) backward (G → F, L → K, A → Z, S → R, S → R). Applying it to METAL gives M → L, E → D, T → S, A → Z, L → K, so the code is LDSZK.

questions.questionText: If PILOT is coded as KDGJO, what is the code for DRIVE under the same rule?
questions.explanationText: Each letter of PILOT is moved 5 position(s) backward (P → K, I → D, L → G, O → J, T → O). Applying it to DRIVE gives D → Y, R → M, I → D, V → Q, E → Z, so the code is YMDQZ.

questions.questionText: If NURSE is coded as LSPQC, what is the code for DOCTOR under the same rule?

questions.questionText: If TIGER is coded as PECAN, what is the code for HORSE under the same rule?

questions.questionText: In a code, every letter is replaced by the letter 3 place(s) ahead of it, the alphabet being treated as cyclic (after Z comes A). What is the code for WAXY?
questions.explanationText: Shifting each letter 3 place(s) forward cyclically: W → Z, A → D, X → A, Y → B. Note the wrap-around (Z → C, A → D). The code is ZDAB.

questions.questionText: In a code, every letter is replaced by the letter 2 place(s) ahead of it, the alphabet being treated as cyclic (after Z comes A). What is the code for AZURE?

questions.questionText: In a code, every letter is replaced by the letter 6 place(s) ahead of it, the alphabet being treated as cyclic (after Z comes A). What is the code for ZONE?
questions.explanationText: Shifting each letter 6 place(s) forward cyclically: Z → F, O → U, N → T, E → K. Note the wrap-around (Z → F, A → G). The code is FUTK.

questions.explanationText: Using the mirror rule, a letter at position p becomes the letter at position 27 - p: C → X, A → Z, T → G. Therefore CAT is coded as XZG.

questions.questionText: If the letters of a word are replaced by their positions in the English alphabet (A = 1, B = 2, ... , Z = 26) and then added, what is the code value of CUP?

questions.questionText: Each letter of a word is shifted 2 place(s) forward to obtain its code. Which of the following words has the code TQRG?

questions.questionText: In a code language 'new book' is written as 'ce li' and 'book on table' is written as 'li pa wo'. What is the code for 'new'?

questions.questionText: If HOT is coded as JQV in a certain language, then which word is coded as EQNF in the same language?
questions.explanationText: From HOT → JQV, the rule is a forward shift of 2. Decoding EQNF by shifting 2 backward: E → C, Q → O, N → L, F → D. The word is COLD.
